posts.text:
Every group that splits season tickets ends up with the same three things: a spreadsheet, a Venmo mess, and one friend who somehow got all the good games.

We built HalfTime to fix that. Here's how it works 🧵

1. Start a pod.

One person creates it for their team, sets everyone's share, and invites the crew. Two people splitting a plan in half, or ten people each taking a slice. Both work.

2. Everyone funds their share into escrow.

Stripe holds the money until the whole pod is committed. If the pod doesn't fill, nobody gets stuck covering someone else's seats.

3. The games get split fairly.

Pick a snake draft, a lottery weighted by ownership, or our fairness engine, which balances marquee games against your share. Every pod gets a 0–100 fairness score so you can see it's even.

4. Can't make a game?

List it on your pod's resale marketplace in seconds, or trade it with a podmate. Taking your dad instead? Send him a guest pass with the game, section, and row in one link.

5. Rivalry night. Playoff game. Everyone wants it.

Pods can auction marquee and playoff games with bid credits, so the big nights go to whoever wants them most, not whoever texted the group chat first.

HalfTime works for NBA, NFL, MLB, NHL, MLS, and college teams. We're onboarding pods by invite right now.

Tell us your team and grab early access: halftime-app.com

The season ticket math:

2 seats
1 of you

Get a pod.
Nobody in a season ticket group chat has ever said "this spreadsheet is working great."

Every season ticket group has one friend who somehow ended up with Opening Night, the rivalry game, and every Saturday.

We built HalfTime for everyone else in that group.

Split season tickets four ways and you learn a lot about your friends.

Mostly who "forgot" to send their share.

Your season tickets don't care that you have a work thing on Tuesday.

Your pod does. Trade it, resell it, or hand it to your cousin with a guest pass.

pillars.title: How it works
pillars.why: One feature per post. Pair with the app screenshots so people see the real product.

posts.text:
How a snake draft splits a season:

Round 1: A → B → C → D
Round 2: D → C → B → A
Round 3: A → B → C → D

Best games go first, and whoever picks last in one round picks first in the next. HalfTime runs the whole draft for your pod in one tap.

"I'll Venmo you Friday" is not a payment plan.

On HalfTime, everyone funds their share up front. Stripe holds it in escrow until the whole pod is in. Nobody gets left holding the bag.

Every HalfTime pod gets a fairness score from 0 to 100.

It checks how close each member landed to their fair share of the season, weighted by game quality. It settles the "you got all the good ones" argument before it starts.

An empty seat is money you already spent.

Can't make a game? List it on your pod's resale marketplace in seconds and get something back.

Got a Tuesday, want a Saturday?

Trade games with anyone in your pod and it settles instantly. No IOUs, no "I'll get you next time."

Giving your ticket to a friend shouldn't take six texts and a blurry screenshot.

Send a HalfTime guest pass: one link with the matchup, venue, section, row, and who it's from.

Your share, your cost, your games, and whether everyone's paid. All on one screen.

This is what a funded pod looks like on HalfTime.

Are you the one who holds the season tickets and chases everyone for money?

Congrats, you're a pod captain. HalfTime handles the collecting and the splitting so you can just go to the game.
